title: NoJumpDelay+
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that removes the hardcoded jump delay in Minecraft, allowing for continuous and fluid jumping.
body:
# NoJumpDelay

A lightweight and performance-friendly Fabric mod designed specifically for Minecraft 1.21.4 that completely removes the hardcoded jump exhaustion/cooldown mechanism from the game. 

In vanilla Minecraft, there is a built-in delay that prevents you from jumping immediately after landing, which can slow down your momentum during intense gameplay. This mod eliminates that restriction entirely.

### Features
* **Continuous Jumping:** Removes the hardcoded jump delay, allowing you to jump instantly and continuously without any deceleration.
* **Fluid Movement:** Enhances movement pacing, making it absolutely perfect for parkour, competitive PvP, and fast-paced environments.
* **Client & Server Compatible:** Works perfectly on both singleplayer worlds and multiplayer servers. It only needs to be installed on the client side to function.![İcon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e52035ed910a3457d70ce026a23084b80d6d49.png)
